verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
When it's all said, when it's all done
I pray I loved You with my whole heart
And made the most of every moment
Every chance that You provided
'Cause it doesn't matter what men say of me

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
So what if I know all the language
So what if I sing all these songs
If my heart is disconnected
From the greatest One of all
So what if my faith could move the mountains
So what if all the lost come when I call
If my heart is disconnected
From the greatest One of all
You're the greatest One of all

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
When I meet You, I pray I knew You
With my whole heart, I pray I loved You
And walked the narrow, fought the good fight
Throughout my days here in this pilgrim life
'Cause it doesn't matter what men say of me

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
I'm making plans now, I'm moving things around
To make you first Lord in this heart of mine
I'm building fences around the precious
And I'm breaking covenant with the worthless
'Cause it doesn't matter what men say of me

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
I want to be great in Your eyes
I want to be great in Your sight
I want to be great in Your eyes
